title: Agentic Explainable Artificial Intelligence (Agentic XAI) Approach To Explore Better Explanation: A Case Study in Decision Support for Rice Cultivation in Japan
abstract: arXiv:2512.21066v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) reveals how explanatory variables relate to a response variable, yet communicating XAI outputs to laypersons remains difficult, limiting trust in AI-based predictions. Large language models (LLMs) can translate technical explanations into accessible narratives, but iterative refinement of XAI explanations by an autonomous LLM agent remains unexplored. This study proposes an agentic XAI framework that combines SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) with iterative refinement by a multimodal LLM and tests it as an agricultural recommendation system on rice yield data from 28 fields in Japan. From a SHAP result, the agent explored additional analyses across 11 refinement rounds (Rounds 0-10). Crop scientists (n = 12) and LLM judges (n = 14) scored every round on seven criteria: Specificity, Clarity, Conciseness, Practicality, Contextual Relevance, Cost Consideration, and Crop Science Credibility. translated_title: 智能体化可解释人工智能方法探索更优解释：日本水稻种植决策支持案例研究
translated_abstract: 可解释人工智能（XAI）能够揭示解释变量与响应变量之间的关系，然而将XAI的输出传达给非专业人士仍然困难，这限制了人们对基于AI预测的信任。大语言模型（LLM）可以将技术性解释转化为通俗易懂的叙述，但由自主LLM智能体对XAI解释进行迭代改进仍是一个未被探索的领域。本研究提出了一种智能体化XAI框架，该框架将SHapley加性解释（SHAP）与多模态LLM的迭代改进相结合，并在日本28个田块的水稻产量数据上将其作为农业推荐系统进行了测试。基于SHAP结果，该智能体在11轮改进（第0-10轮）中探索了额外的分析。作物科学家（n = 12）和LLM评审（n = 14）根据七项标准对每一轮进行评分：具体性、清晰性、简洁性、实用性、情境相关性、成本考量以及作物科学可信度。
tldr: 本研究提出一种智能体化可解释AI（Agentic XAI）框架，将SHAP分析与多模态大语言模型的自主迭代改进相结合，并在日本水稻产量决策支持案例中，通过作物科学家和LLM评审依据七项标准对11轮改进结果进行评分，验证了该方法能生成更优质、更易懂的AI解释。
en_tdlr: This study proposes an agentic XAI framework that combines SHAP with iterative refinement by a multimodal LLM, validated as an agricultural decision support system on rice yield data in Japan through evaluations of 11 refinement rounds by crop scientists and LLM judges across seven criteria.
